decisions.reason: As the successor to the withdrawn Universal Analytics offer and a close fit with the firm's core analytics and shop-technology positioning, management is likely to stay committed and explain any weak performance as temporary rather than abandon it now.

The retail system interface plugin draws on the firm's integration capabilities and existing development effort, so management is inclined to persist, though its lower public visibility makes withdrawal somewhat more conceivable than for the more prominently presented services.

Because the shop relaunch SEO support service has its own page and sits squarely within the firm's publicly stated full-service e-commerce offer, management is likely to keep backing it and justify patience through long client decision and relaunch cycles.

As a newly launched workshop offer with its own page and a clear connection to the firm's SEO expertise, management is likely to continue it for another year and attribute limited uptake to normal ramp-up rather than failure.
